protocol.training: One separate MOVE-CHECK-CLICK demonstration per edge; no full route
protocol.capacity: At most 20 demonstrated edges: production learner limit of 20 lessons; no bypass
protocol.weights: Controlled initial backward confidence .84..98; equal_diamond .9; same memory for all arms
protocol.learning: Off throughout; tests composition and goal replacement, not adaptation
protocol.low_threshold_reason: Pure sensory contribution is at most .25; 1e-6 extra still requires goal history
protocol.dijkstra: Existing weighted Dijkstra criterion, policy cached across fragments; invalidated on goal/graph edits
protocol.goal_change: Public start_goals API resets current episode and waves for every selector
protocol.delivery: during_spread: after 2 selector calls, A->B; after_click: initial vertex 2 -> vertex 0 after first acknowledged click; pending_click: initial vertex 2 -> A, queued at click dispatch and delivered after its receipt
protocol.scoring: Oracle uses private world graph; success and correct unreachable refusal reported separately; unreachable assessed at actual goal delivery location
protocol.advantage: Higher paired correctness, fewer off-goal/failed actions, or lower latency at equal correctness; report every family and scenario, no tuning on held-out results
protocol.tie_policy: Both equal-cost routes are valid; native ambiguity is a refusal, not a correctness advantage
protocol.limits: Same 100 waves, 1800 ticks per goal; host cap 1900 iterations; no OS, LLM or perception-noise test
